name: Mikey
source: Mikey is an extroverted and artistic human male that enjoys painting and hates the texture of styrofoam and clay. He grew up from humble beginnings but luckily earned a scholarship to a liberal arts college through his connections. He pursues inspiration to an unhealthy extent and will do whatever it takes to remain on top of his class, whether by charming his classmates or disposing of people who know the truth behind him and his associates.
